colors._note: sRGB hex. albedo = the cloud's cool-white scattering albedo (the mass reads as storm_slate #3E4A57 through its own shadow); wound = spawn_wound (rent surfaces), held = glimmer_held (light pooled inside and the motes shed), lightning = ch20 key #C4D6FF, foam = foam_white, sea_deep = abyss_navy. Palette hexes are tested against docs/kb/art/palette.json. lift = glimmer_lift (the Letting: the wounds and held light turn to it as they start to rise, M2-RND-05).

state._note: Runtime API ranges and defaults (UndertowStorm exports).

shape._note: Metres, storm-local (origin = eye centre at sea level). The Undertow is kilometres wide (bible §9).

flow._note: Differential rotation: omega(r) = rotation_rad_s * (eye_radius / r)^falloff. Two-phase advection over cycle_s keeps the noise from winding up forever.

wounds._note: Rents where held light bleeds out (bible §9). Seams drift DOWN the wall (held light sinks, colour script rule 1). M2-RND-05 torn rents: a dark torn lip lip_width seam widths wide around each open core (lit colour x (1 - lip_dark)), and a halo halo_width wide where the light pouring out scatters in the cloud beside it (halo_energy x the seam glow).

lightning._note: Deterministic schedule (UndertowState.flash_levels). Sites ride the eyewall and rotate with it.

sea._note: The maelstrom: the sea pulled down into the eye. Profile = funnel (depth_m, Gaussian-ish throat) + lip (surge heaped against the wall).

sea_response._note: M2-RND-01: the zone sea answering the storm (water shader group 'storm', set by UndertowStorm on its `water`). Within reach_m of the storm's centre the sea darkens toward it, turns choppier and rougher, and carries wind streaks drawn in toward it; darken, chop, roughness and streak_amount scale with storm_intensity.

shells._note: Low tier body: open lathe shells mapped onto the same envelope the raymarch uses. fraction = position across the wall (0 eye face, 1 outer face).

motes._note: GlimmerField (held) for motes torn off the wounds that have drifted ashore. Placed by the zone; amount follows glimmer.json tiers.

render_priority._note: Transparent sort: lid < water (0) < spray (inner curtain, behind the wall) < body < spray_outer (the near half of the outer curtain, in front of the wall's foot; M2-RND-01) < motes drawn over the storm. M2-RND-05: streamers (near half, over the wall) < bolts < motes < rain (near-field curtains over everything; one priority per layer from rain).

looks._note: Named storm looks (UndertowStorm.look): shader uniform -> value, pushed on top of the tunables to every storm material. '#hex' strings are sRGB colours. M1-RND-09.

day_storm._note: Daylight storm wall (colour script Ch1 storm / Ch8 'The Seawall'; bible: 'a wall of dark water and cloud lit from within by glimmer'). Albedo toward storm_slate (#3E4A57; lit flanks near its +1 stop), more ambient self-shadow, and a high sun that reaches the lower wall (sun_low_floor / sun_clear_height: the dusk defaults assume a low sun already crossed the outer bands), so a 30-degree afternoon sun reads as a slate wall standing on the sea, not a khaki cumulonimbus or a sandstorm.

noise._note: Baked value-noise lattice the raymarched body samples instead of hashing (M1-RND-10): assets_src/vfx/undertow/bake_noise3d.py. texels = the bake's SIZE.

lid._note: Depth-only disc over the funnel (undertow_sea_lid.gdshader), radius = sea.fade_start_m, height = sea.lift_m + the zone's crest height + margin_m. Drawn just before the water.

unbinding._note: The Letting (UndertowStorm.unbinding, Ch21; M2-RND-05). Over its first half the wounds' and throat streaks' drift reverses from sinking to rising at rise_ratio x their sink speeds; over its second half their colours lerp to colors.lift (colour script rule 1).

streamers._note: M2-RND-05: curtains of held light hanging off the wall's wounds (anchors on the outer face inside the wounds' height window) down to the sea: they fall as (1 - t)^drop, bulge reach_m out from the face toward the foot, trail twist_rad sideways and widen from 0.5 to 1.5 x width_m; motes slide down them with the wounds' drift. Count per tier in quality.streamers.

bolts._note: M2-RND-05: cloud-to-sea strokes at a flash site's strike (UndertowEvents). A scheduled strike shows one with `chance`; force_flash always does. From the cloud base (top_m) over the site's wall angle to the sea sea_reach_m (x 0.5..1.5) beyond the wall, angle spread spread_rad; jag = sideways kink per step; width_m with a min_px pixel floor. Forks per tier in quality.bolt_branches.

exposure_flash._note: M2-RND-05: the colour script's lightning frames (Ch8: 2.0x exposure for 2 frames) on UndertowStorm.world_environment at each strike. Photosensitivity as battle flashes (battle_vfx.md): at least min_interval_s apart (at most two a second, under WCAG 2.3.1's three), and reduced_motion_gain under UiSettings reduced motion.

rain._note: M2-RND-05: near-field rain curtains on the camera (UndertowRain), full within full_m of the eye, none beyond reach_m (the outer rain bands), times intensity; UndertowStorm.rain_amount overrides. Layers per tier in quality.rain_layers (radii_m, inner first). color = lit rain at ambient 1; flash_gain = how much a strike lights it. ceiling_m: none with the camera above it (over the sea), so a camera over the storm stays dry.

zone_shadow._note: M2-RND-05: the zone's key light and ambient dim (sun_dim, ambient_dim at full shadow) while the storm's canopy is overhead (overhead x the canopy footprint, soft over soft_m) or the canopy or wall stands between the zone marker (the storm node) and the sun; times intensity. The storm itself stays lit by the undimmed key.

reflection._note: M2-RND-05: the storm in the zone water's reflection (water shader storm group). Where the half-res body's frame exists (Medium, High), the reflected ray's point at the storm's distance is projected to the screen and the storm's own pixel is reflected. Elsewhere (off screen, Low shells, Ultra's full-res body) an impostor of two vertical cylinders (wall and canopy ring) the reflected ray tests, coloured low = ambient bottom x low_gain at the sea to high = albedo x key x sun_gain + ambient top x low_gain at the top, plus lightning (flash_gain) and the wounds (wound_gain); the gains are matched to the body's measured on-screen colour (it is several times darker than a naive albedo x key). Where the storm is reflected the sky reflection gives way to it. strength x intensity; edges soft over soft_m.

presets._note: M2-RND-05: chapter presets (UndertowStorm.preset / apply_preset): storm property -> value. Starting points from the colour script, for Art's sign-off (M2-ART-03); a cutscene tweens between them. The zone still owns its light (key, fog, exposure: color_script.md).

ch01_arrival._note: Ch1 'Lamp-Diver': the storm arrives at 11:10 out of a clear sky over the raft-town (day look, still far off, wounds held back).

ch08_seawall._note: Ch8 'The Seawall', 16:00: the daylight storm wall standing on the sea (the undertow_day_ch08 reference).

ch08_landfall._note: Ch8 by 16:40: the storm 'darkens to near-night'; the zone is under the canopy's edge, just outside the wall (9.2 km at the sea), so the zone shadow is full and the rain heavy.

ch20_interior._note: Ch20 'Undertow': inside the storm, no sun; the wounds and lightning are the light.

ch21_heart._note: Ch21 'The Heart', phases 1-2: the core, every wound open, all of it held.

ch21_letting._note: Ch21 phase 3, the Letting: held light turns to released (tween unbinding 0 -> 1 over the countdown); the storm unwinds.
